result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Australia, my top recommendation would be **Stripe**, unless you're using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your website platform, transaction volume and whether you sell locally or internationally.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian online store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

Domestic cards: 1.7% + \$0.30 AUD

- No monthly fee on standard pricing.
- Easy integration with most online stores.
- Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent fraud prevention and reporting.
- Good for subscriptions and international sales.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com/au) · [Pricing](https://stripe.com/au/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

Basic plan: 1.75% + \$0.30 AUD domestic cards

- Built directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway required.
- Integrated order and payment management.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

Online cards: approximately 2.2%

- Simple to set up.
- Particularly good if you also sell in person.
- Combines online and physical payments.
- Useful inventory and sales management.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/au/en)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

Standard domestic checkout: approximately 2.9% + \$0.30

- Many customers already trust and use it.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal accounts.
- Good additional checkout option.
- Generally more expensive than Stripe.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

Fees are indicative Australian rates; international cards, currency conversion and specific plans can cost more. Sources: [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For most new small online stores\:

- **Stripe\:** Start here if you want flexibility and competitive processing fees.
- **Shopify Payments\:** Choose this if your store runs on Shopify.
- **PayPal\:** Consider offering it alongside your main processor to give customers another way to pay.

I wouldn't necessarily use multiple payment processors as your primary setup. Keep things simple initially.

## Let me narrow it down to the best option for your store

\$20,000–\$50,000

\$50,000+

---

**3\. Where are your customers?**

Worldwide

---

**4\. What do you sell?**
